spec.expr: sum by(jvm_gc_action, jvm_gc_name, container, pod, namespace) (histogram_sum(rate(jvm_gc_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container", service=~"$app"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by(jvm_gc_action, jvm_gc_name, container, pod, namespace) (histogram_avg(rate(jvm_gc_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container", service=~"$app"}[$__rate_interval])))
sum by(container, pod) (rate(jvm_cpu_time_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container", service=~"$app"}[$__rate_interval]))
